name: Turns Out My Pretty Boy is a Billionaire
original_name: Turns Out My Pretty Boy is a Billionaire
overview:
Mia is a glamorous TV anchor—but behind the fame, she’s been betrayed by her family, friends, and husband.

Adopted by a wealthy family as a child, she once lived a life of love and luxury. But when the “real daughter” returns, Mia’s perfect world crumbles—her family turns cold, and her husband cheats with her best friend.

At her lowest point, she meets the breathtakingly handsome Henry. She thought he was just a struggling model, so she supported him for three years. But when her husband and his mistress come back into her life, Mia is forced to end her secret relationship with Henry.
